population_one_line: Neutropenic hematological malignancy patients with BSI, China, 2015-2021
outcome_one_line: Mortality 17.7%; risk factors include severe neutropenia >7d, unreasonable empirical therapy
notes: TTP/time to positivity not measured or analyzed. Risk factor analysis is for mortality with non-TTP predictors.

population_one_line: Single case report of persistent bacteremia with R. pickettii and Microbacterium
ttp_reported: mentioned >48h in background as contamination cutoff
notes: Case report (n=1), excluded per wrong_design (case report <10).

population_one_line: GP BSI patients pre/post ePlex BCID-GP panel implementation, IDWeek 2021 abstract
outcome_one_line: Time to targeted therapy reduced by ~24h with rapid diagnostic
notes: Conference abstract only (OFID 2021 supplement, IDWeek). No TTP analyzed.

population_one_line: Nocardia bacteremia single-center case series (n=4) plus systematic literature review
notes: Conference abstract (IDWeek 2019 supplement) - single-center series of only 4 cases plus narrative review. wrong_design.

population_one_line: Adult monomicrobial Pseudomonas aeruginosa BSI, 3 hospitals Tubingen Germany, 2006-2012
ttp_reported: TTP from aerobic BACTEC bottles; cutpoint 18h identified by ROC
outcome_one_line: In-hospital mortality: multivariate Cox HR 3.83 (P=0.012) for TTP <=18h
notes: Clear include. TTP measured and analyzed as predictor of in-hospital mortality with multivariable Cox regression.

population_one_line: Adult MSSA bacteremia comparing empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin, Vancouver Canada 2007-2014
ttp_reported: Median TTP 20h (IQR 16.5-24.9) beta-lactam vs 18.3h (15.9-23.5) vancomycin, p=0.17
outcome_one_line: 28d mortality adjusted OR 0.85 (0.27-2.67) for beta-lactam vs vancomycin; TTP described only as baseline characteristic
notes: TTP reported descriptively as baseline characteristic; no quantitative TTP-outcome association analyzed.

population_one_line: Adult MSSA bacteremia comparing empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin, Vancouver Canada 2007-2014
ttp_reported: Median TTP 20.2h (16.6-25.5) beta-lactam vs 18.5h (16.2-23.3) vancomycin, p=0.02
outcome_one_line: 28d mortality adjusted OR 1.14 (0.49-2.64) for beta-lactam vs vancomycin; TTP only baseline
notes: TTP reported only as descriptive baseline characteristic. No TTP-outcome quantitative analysis. Likely overlaps with Wong2016_a (same authors, similar dataset, expanded n).

population_one_line: Adult S. aureus bacteremia, persistent (>48h) vs non-persistent, Chinese tertiary hospital 2020-2024
ttp_reported: TTP not reported (only as reference citation)
outcome_one_line: pSAB predictors: CCI>=7 OR 4.09, IE OR 8.66, preadmission fever >=7d OR 5.06; pSAB associated with increased 30d mortality and relapse
notes: Outcome is persistence (>48h bacteremia) but TTP itself not measured/analyzed. Persistent bacteremia is defined by duration of bacteremia, not blood culture TTP.

population_one_line: Candidemia cases (n=67) vs non-candidemia controls (n=67), Chinese single center 2013-2024
outcome_one_line: TTP>=2d OR 121.03 (22.61-647.95) - but this predicts candidemia status vs non-candidemia, NOT clinical outcome
notes: Logistic regression uses TTP to predict candidemia diagnosis (classification), not a clinical outcome (mortality/persistence/clearance). Mortality is only descriptively compared between groups. Does not meet TTP-clinical outcome association criterion.

population_one_line: Adult patients with positive blood cultures for Corynebacterium spp., Japan single center 2014-2016
ttp_reported: Median TTP 1 day (IQR 1-1) bacteremia vs 2 days (1-2) contamination, p=0.009
outcome_one_line: TTP compared between bacteremia vs contamination (microbiology classification); 4/27 bacteremia patients died (descriptive only)
notes: TTP compared between bacteremia and contamination groups, which is a microbiologic classification, not a clinical outcome. Mortality reported descriptively without TTP analysis.
